reviews.title: I Hate This App
reviews.text:
This app has left me in a severe state of depression and after recognising this app has brought me to this stage of severe depression and mental heath I have deleted it and now writing this review to warn others that you are not alone with these absolute bizarre streaks. I Love God I hate the App. STOP THE STREAKS. for someone who like me has OCD and wanted to keep up with logging in every day I as a human and as a Christian struggle. I’m a broken man and this app is designed to Absolutely destroy you. I was feeling bad and down one day and though I’ll log into my app to find all my streak had gone and that the only way to get them back was by a stupid email them you have to wait. By that time I’ve already started the process of ending my life in my head. Yes all over these STUPID streaks. Can’t turn them off? No the devs won’t let you? Why? Well God gave us free will to come to him. This app feels like you are forced to be in Gods word. As a gamer I like to be consistent too so these streaks I thought was initially fun but that turned into me wanting to end my life. 

SORT THIS OUT DEVS. NOW. give the customers freedom to connect with God and allow those who cannot or find it hard mentally to switch of THE FRIGGIN STREAKS MAN!!!!!!!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhh!!!!!!!

reviews.title: “Privacy” Policy👎
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for years and never had this forced Privacy Policy rubbish. I am extremely disappointed with this app’s Privacy Policy. The explanations given for collecting and using personal data feel unreasonable and do not align with the values the app claims to represent. For an app centered around faith, trust, and integrity, the level of data collection comes across as hypocritical and leaves many users feeling uncomfortable.

What makes this even more frustrating is that when the app asks users to leave feedback or a review, it then requires an email address before allowing them to do so. If users are already concerned about privacy, asking for even more personal information only reinforces those concerns.

I came to this app expecting a focus on Scripture and spiritual growth, not policies that make me question how my information is being handled. Unless there is greater transparency and respect for user privacy, I cannot recommend this app.

To make matters worse, the policy appears to mention collecting certain banking or financial information. That raises even more questions. This is a Bible app, so it is difficult to understand why any banking-related information would be necessary in the first place. Without a clear and convincing explanation, requests for that kind of sensitive data feel excessive and further undermine trust in the platform.
